name: tilt-spring-card
title: Tilt Spring Card
description: Pointer-driven 3D tilt with a real spring integrator: rotation chases the pointer through a damped spring rather than lerping, so quick circles overshoot and settle — the difference between a transition and a physical object.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Pointer Tilt: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
